messages:
maya: Quick sync — need a sequenced ramp plan for Acme pilot. Legal insists on a customer-side kill switch + cryptographic audit trail. They also want the ability to adjust canary percent from their ops console. Thoughts?

alex: We can surface a flag variant `acme_pilot_mode` with `customer_controlled=true` and a secure webhook for their on-call to request flips. Control plane verifies signature and emits an audit entry.

sam: Sales requests a written SLA carve-out for pilot: 'soft SLA' until full rollout. Need clear behavior when kill switch is used (graceful degrade -> route to hosted-lite model).

joni: Ops preference: do NOT let external webhooks flip runtime flags directly. Proposed flow: webhook -> signed request to control plane -> operator approval step for untrusted sources; for trusted enterprise customers allow bypass with pre-authorized creds.

maya: Can we let them move canary from 1% -> 5% -> 20% live via the console? They want to self-advance during their testing window.

eli: Yes — we have percent-based routing buckets. Must add guardrail: max increase X% per Y minutes and automated revert if error-rate > threshold (e.g., 0.5% or latency > 2x baseline).

sam: Also require a customer-initiated rollback record that writes to a KMS-backed audit log (immutable). Marketing will want language for enterprise buyers.

alex: POC flag schema (for internal reference):
```
{
  "flag": "acme-sequenced-ramp",
  "variants": ["off", "on-lite", "on-full"],
  "percent_rules": [{"variant":"on-lite","pct":1},{"variant":"on-full","pct":0}],
  "customer_controlled": true,
  "audit_hook": "https://controlplane.redwood.example/hooks/acme"
}
```

joni: ops-bot: canary-run should post periodic summaries to #eng-oncall with latency, error-rate, token-usage, and a rollback recommendation. Add a one-click 'manual override' link for SREs to execute emergency route changes.

ops-bot: Canary run started — baseline latency 43ms, error-rate 0.12% — monitoring active :eyes: (will post updates every 5m).

maya: Good. Need a compact launch criteria list for Sales & Legal signoff.

alex: Draft launch criteria: 1) Signed MSA addendum covering kill-switch + audit obligations; 2) Audit logging enabled and retention policy (90d); 3) Canary automation + clear rollback policy; 4) Emergency routing path to hosted-lite variant; 5) Customer ops onboarding + runbook; 6) Billing cap during pilot.

sam: Add: 'cost cap' and 'billing freeze' clause for pilot. Also define SLO relaxation thresholds during pilot.

maya: Action items: alex -> draft public-facing playbook and MSA language; ops (joni) -> implement approval workflow; infra (eli) -> add percent-increase guardrail + auto-revert; ops-bot -> wire canary posts to #eng-oncall; target pilot start: next Tue EOD.

alex: On it. I'll open a PR to product-playbooks with the draft and tag @maya for review.

maya: Thanks everyone :tada: Will loop in legal & sales after PR.
